data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2016 Syndicate 33 reported a gross claims outstanding opening position of GBP 1,222.2m and a gross prior year over-provision of GBP 173.2m (a c.14.2% release of opening reserves) disclosed in the technical provisions movement. This prior year movement is presented as an 'over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses' and reflects favourable claims development / IBNR recalibration across the portfolio. No single prior-year event is quantified as driving the movement in the notes.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary sources used: Balance sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding) and Note 10 technical provisions movement table for gross 'Over-provision in respect of prior claims'. The gross prior year movement is taken directly from the technical provisions movement table (gross column). No explicit narrative attribution of the movement by specific underwriting years or LOBs was provided; the claims development triangle is available (gross) and consistent with the disclosure. RITC entries exist elsewhere in the report (underwriting year accounts) but the technical provisions movement used here is post any such adjustments. Confidence is high for numeric values extracted from tables.
